description: Wooden barrel: a bulged body of faceted staves with a recessed lid, and metal hoops. Pivot at the centre of the base, axis Y. Pieces: barrel_body (wood), barrel_hoops (metal_dark). Every piece is closed.

bulge.desc: extra radius at the middle, as a fraction of radius

seed.desc: random seed of the stave tint

profile.note: half profile in the XY plane from the bottom centre around to the top centre, with a recessed lid

body_paint.note: Cd = the material's base colour, tinted per stave

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const a = Math.atan2(@P.z, @P.x); const k = 0.75 + 0.4 * rand(Math.floor((a + PI) / TAU * staves + 0.5), seed); @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
